engineFlags.commandSnippet: ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:0,1,2,3 GGML_SYCL_Q8_0_WOQ_BF16=1 GGML_SYCL_Q8_0_WOQ_FIXED16=1 GGML_SYCL_BF16_GRAPH_CONVERSION_CACHE=0 GGML_META_PARALLEL_SUBMIT=1 GGML_SYCL_COMM_ARGMAX=1 LLAMA_DFLASH_TP_GREEDY=1 LLAMA_TP_BACKEND_SAMPLING=1 llama-server -m Muse-Glimmer-30B-UD-Q8_K_XL.gguf -ngl 99 -c 32768 --parallel 1 -b 1024 -ub 1024 -fa on -sm tensor -bs -lv 4 --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-model dflash-bf16.gguf --spec-draft-n-max 15 --spec-draft-p-min 0 --spec-draft-ngl 99

payload.notes: Muse-Glimmer-30B UD-Q8_K_XL on four Intel Arc Pro B70 GPUs, TP4, one cold request at a time. Primary result is the median across a frozen 15-prompt suite for the 99 inter-token intervals between generated-token events 1 and 100 after TTFT: 161.900 tok/s; p10 108.574, mean 175.813, prompt-bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound 127.082. Every prompt ran exactly once, all reported cached_tokens=0, and no prompt/KV/context/response/ngram/history reuse was used. Pretrained BF16 DFlash proposals are verified by the declared Q8 target; no drafter training was performed. Runtime uses fixed-N16 BF16-activation/S8 group32 oneDNN WOQ and distributed ARGMAX. This is a target-verified Q8 result, not BF16/lossless or universally token-exact; two deterministic structured tasks were exact while prose can take target-approved near-tie branches. Full natural-completion median after TTFT was 68.586 tok/s. Complete patches, configs, hashes, raw evidence, and runnable repro are in results/muse-glimmer-30b-q8-woq-b70 and repro/muse-glimmer-30b-q8-woq-b70-100tps-20260813.
